cohort: The study included 184 fetuses from twin pregnancies (19 monochorionic and 73 dichorionic gestations) from the twin pregnancy database of Centro Hospitalar Sao Joao.
finding: Mean first-trimester uterine artery pulsatility index (UtA-PI), but not crown-rump length discordance (CRLD), was significantly associated with growth discordance (GD) and severe GD in twin pregnancies.
